hook: Skipping your 401(k) match is like turning down a raise.

cast.Sam: a cartoon office worker in his late 20s, messy brown hair, big expressive eyes, mint-green sweater over a white collar, yellow lanyard

blocks.narration: Skipping your 401(k) match is like turning down a raise. Many American employers add money when you save. Plenty of workers leave it unclaimed.
blocks.visual: Young office worker at a desk pushes away a glowing envelope stamped with a dollar sign, coworkers in the background, slow push-in

shots.visual: Sam at his desk, frowning at a glowing envelope marked with a dollar sign held out to him
shots.action: He shoves the glowing envelope away across the desk with a dismissive flick, then smirks

shots.visual: A friendly cartoon manager beside a giant piggy bank in a bright open office
beats: the manager tips a stack of gold coins toward the piggy bank
coins pour in one after another, bouncing off the rim
the piggy bank swells and the manager snaps a thumbs-up

shots.visual: A pile of unopened glowing envelopes on Sam's empty desk at night
beats: the desk lamp flickers off
the envelopes curl at the edges, then crumble into glowing dust

blocks.narration: Here is how it works. If your company matches fifty percent up to six percent, saving six percent gets you three percent extra.
blocks.visual: Two stacks of coins grow side by side on a paycheck, the second stack labeled 'match' rises halfway as fast, bold numbers 6% and 3% pop in

shots.visual: Sam's paycheck lying on a desk, two empty glass jars beside it
beats: a spotlight snaps on over the paycheck
its light slides across to the two empty jars

shots.visual: Two glass jars side by side under a coin slot
beats: coins pour into the left jar and stop at the middle line
a thinner stream starts into the right jar
the right jar fills to half with a final clink

shots.visual: Sam holding both full jars of gold coins, grinning
beats: Sam lifts the jars overhead
confetti bursts down around him

blocks.narration: On a sixty thousand dollar salary, that is eighteen hundred dollars a year, every year, a raise you already earned and never collected.
blocks.visual: Calendar pages flip while a jar labeled 'retirement' fills with coins, ending on a phone screen showing a benefits portal checkbox being ticked

shots.visual: A cartoon salary slip floating in front of a city skyline at sunset
beats: the slip spins toward the camera
it unfolds with a snap

shots.visual: A tall stack of gold coins on a table, Sam peeking over it
beats: coins stack up one by one beside Sam
the stack shoots past his head
Sam's eyes go wide

shots.visual: Sam at his desk holding the glowing envelope from the opening, now torn open, gold light on his face
beats: Sam tears the envelope open
gold light bursts out across his face
he grins straight into the camera

cta: Follow for one money rule a day.
visual_style: Stylized 3D animated film look, Pixar-quality expressive cartoon characters, bold saturated colors, clean simple backgrounds, soft studio lighting

captions.hook_line: Your 401(k) match is a raise you might be skipping 💸
captions.body: If your employer matches contributions, saving at least up to the match is the easiest return you'll ever get. Look up your plan's match formula today.
captions.comment_prompt: Did you know the match counts as part of your pay?
